name: Aggressive Hunter
summary: In your opponent's Shooting phase, if a model in this unit was destroyed by an enemy unit's attacks, this unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

name: Aggressive Reconnaissance
summary: In your Shooting phase, this unit's ranged attacks that target an enemy unit that is not within 6" of any other enemy units have +1 to wound rolls.

name: Alpha Hunter
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit gain the Scouts 6" ability.

name: Alpha Predator
summary: When this model ends a Charge move, target an enemy unit within Engagement Range and roll a D6: 2-3 deals D3 mortal wounds, 4-5 deals 3 mortal wounds, 6 deals D3+3 mortal wounds.

name: Armour of Fate
summary: The first time this model is destroyed, roll a D6 at the end of the phase; on 3+, return it to the battlefield near where it fell, out of Engagement Range, with 6 wounds remaining.

name: ATTACHED UNITS
summary: Lets a Leader character that could attach to one named unit also attach to this unit.

name: Author of the Codex
summary: In your Movement phase, you can select one visible friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within 12" of this model, and select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for that unit, in addition to any other combat doctrines that are active for that unit, until the start of your next Command phase.

name: Banner of Macragge
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured. Once per battle, per army, when this unit is selected to fight, you can use this ability; if you do, this unit's melee attacks have +1 A and +1 S.

name: Berserk Fury
summary: Charge rolls made for this unit can be re-rolled.

name: Blackwing Mantle
summary: You can target this unit with Rapid Ingress or Heroic Intervention for -1 CP, regardless of other uses of that stratagem this phase; it does not prevent other units from also using it.

name: Blackwing Mantle (Once per phase, per army)
summary: Once per phase, per army: you can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that Stratagem this phase. If you do: that use is -1 CP; and that use does not prevent any uses of that Stratagem on other units this phase.

name: Bladeguard (Once per turn, per unit)
summary: Once per turn, per unit. In the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to fight or when an enemy unit targets this unit, select one of the following: this unit's melee attacks have +1 to hit rolls; or attacks that target this unit have -1 to hit rolls.

name: Blessings of the Omnissiah
summary: In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit's move, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model within 3" of this model. That Vehicle model heals D3 wounds. That Vehicle model's attacks can ignore modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls until the start of your next Movement phase.

name: Bolter Discipline
summary: In your Shooting phase, this unit's ranged attacks have +1 to hit rolls if either of the following applies: this unit is within range of an objective; or the target of that attack is within range of an objective.

name: Born of Wolves
summary: While this model leads a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit gain the Sustained Hits 1 ability.

name: Brutalis Charge (Once per phase, per unit)
summary: Once per phase, per unit: you can target this unit with the Crushing Impact stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do, that use is -1 CP, and that use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

name: Calgar’s Champion
summary: This model's attacks that target a CHARACTER unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and can re-roll wound rolls of 1.

name: Captain of the Honour Guard
summary: If your army includes a Marneus Calgar unit, this unit's Leader ability is replaced with the Support ability. This unit can still be attached to the same units.

name: Cerebrex Logic Engine
summary: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit. That unit has Scouts 6".

name: Chainsword Doctrines
summary: When this unit fights, choose Sustained Hits 1, Lethal Hits, or Lance for its Astartes chainswords until the end of the phase.

name: Chameleoline Cloaks
summary: This unit has -3" detection range.

name: CHAPTER MASTER OF THE RAVEN GUARD
summary: At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, if your army includes AETHON SHAAN and Kayvaan Shrike, then until the end of the battle your KAYVAAN SHRIKE unit loses its Lone Operative ability and replaces its CHAPTER MASTER keyword with CAPTAIN.

name: Chief Librarian (psyker level 3)
summary: This model has the psychic abilities listed in the Psychic Abilities section.

name: Chosen Companions
summary: While a Character leads this unit, each attack made by a model in the unit adds 1 to the Hit roll.

name: Chronus
summary: When this model disembarks from the Vehicle it was commanding, it gains the Lone Operative ability for the rest of the battle.

name: Close In for the Kill
summary: When this model attacks an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

name: Close-quarters Firestorm
summary: This unit's attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of this unit have +1 Strength.

name: Codex Adept
summary: The assault doctrine, the devastator doctrine, and the tactical doctrine are all active for this unit at the same time.

name: Cold and Calculating
summary: In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to attack, select one of the following for this unit's attacks to have: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle]; or [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle]; or, if the tactical doctrine is active for this unit, both [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle] and [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle].

name: Combat Embarkation
summary: In your opponent's Charge phase, when an enemy unit has selected charge targets, you can select one friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit that was one of those charge targets and is eligible to embark within this TRANSPORT. If every model in that unit is within 3" of this TRANSPORT, that unit can embark within this TRANSPORT. That enemy unit can then select new charge targets for that charge move.

name: Combat Shield
summary: This model has 5+ InSv.

name: COMMAND SQUAD BODYGUARD
summary: A Character model from your army with the Leader ability that can be attached to a Bike Squad (Outrider Squad) can be attached to this unit instead.

name: Concealed Positions
summary: This unit can only be targeted by a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 12".

name: Crewed Artillery
summary: If one model in this unit is destroyed, the other model in the unit is destroyed as well.

name: CRIMSON FISTS
summary: This model belongs to a named successor Chapter and is treated as a model of its parent Chapter for rules purposes, but cannot be included alongside other Epic Heroes of that parent Chapter.

name: DEATH COMPANY
summary: A Chaplain model from your army with the Leader ability that can be attached to a Tactical Squad can be attached to this unit instead. A Character unit from your army with the Leader ability that can be attached to a Death Company Marines unit can be attached to this unit instead.

name: Death-hold
summary: This model does not suffer the ranged-attack Hit roll penalty for being within Engagement Range of an enemy unit.

name: Deathstorm Assault
summary: This model must start the battle in Reserves without counting against normal Reserves limits, and can arrive in the Reinforcements step of your first, second, or third Movement phase regardless of mission rules.

name: Deeds of Legend
summary: While this unit is within range of an objective, this unit's melee attacks have +1 A.

name: Defensive Array (Once per phase, per unit)
summary: Once per phase, per unit: you can target this unit with the Fire Overwatch stratagem regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do, that use is -1 CP.

name: DEMETRIAN TITUS
summary: Army composition limit: an army can include a maximum of one Titus unit.

name: Demi-company Commander (Once per turn, per unit)
summary: Once per turn, per unit. When a friendly Captain unit uses its Strategic Acumen ability, you can use this ability. If you do, the selected combat doctrine is active for this unit until the start of your next Command phase.

name: Divinator-class Auspexes (Once per phase, per unit)
summary: Once per phase, per unit. In your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot, you can use this ability. If you do, select one visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit; that unit is scanned. While a unit is scanned, ranged attacks that target that unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

name: Driven from Cover
summary: In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, select one enemy unit that was hit by those attacks. Ranged attacks made by friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units that target that enemy unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

name: Echo of the Ravenspire
summary: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, if this unit is unengaged, you can place this unit in strategic reserves.

name: Embittered
summary: The first time this model is attacked, after that attacking unit finishes its attacks, this model's named weapon permanently gains an Attacks characteristic of 12 for the rest of the battle.

name: Evade and Survive (Once per phase, per unit)
summary: Once per phase, per unit. In your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

name: Finest Hour (Once per battle, per unit)
summary: Usable once per battle, per unit. In the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to fight, you can use this ability. If you do, this model's melee attacks have +3 A and [Devastating Wounds].

name: Fire and Redeploy
summary: After this model shoots, if it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy, it can make a further Normal move of up to D6", but becomes ineligible to charge that turn.

name: Fire Discipline
summary: Each time this unit Remains Stationary, if it includes a Long Fang Pack Leader, you can select one enemy unit visible to that model. Until the end of the turn, each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack targeting that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

name: Fire Supprt
summary: In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. Attacks that target that unit made by friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units that Disembarked from this TRANSPORT this turn can re-roll wound rolls.

name: FLESH TEARERS
summary: This model belongs to a named successor Chapter and is treated as a model of its parent Chapter for rules purposes, but cannot be included alongside other Epic Heroes of that parent Chapter.

name: Flexible Asset
summary: When this unit is selected to make an Advance or Fall Back move, that Advance or Fall Back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.

name: For the Khan!
summary: This unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. This unit's melee attacks have [LANCE].

name: Force Dome (psychic level 1)
summary: In your Movement phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do: on a 1, this unit is battle-shocked; and this unit has 4+ InSv until the start of your next turn.

name: Forgefather
summary: In your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 24" of this model. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units' [Melta]/[Torrent] attacks that target that enemy unit have +2 S.

name: Forward Assault Warsuit
summary: At the start of the first battle round, you can select one enemy unit to be this unit's mark. This unit's attacks that target this unit's mark can re-roll wound rolls of 1. Each time this unit's mark is destroyed, select one enemy unit to be this unit's mark.

name: Frenzied Reprisal
summary: Once per turn, after an enemy unit that targeted this unit in the Fight phase finishes attacking, this unit becomes eligible to fight again and must be selected to fight next.

name: Frozen Prey
summary: After this model shoots, if an enemy Monster or Vehicle was hit by this model's named weapon, until the end of the opponent's next turn it is Frozen: -2 to its Move characteristic and -2 to Advance and Charge rolls.

name: Full-throttle Assault
summary: If this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit's Thunder Hammer weapons have +1 to hit rolls and [Sustained Hits 1], and this unit's other melee weapons have +1 D and [Sustained Hits 1].

name: Fury of the Machine Spirit
summary: This unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 12" of this unit have [Lethal Hits].

name: Gifted Commander
summary: While this model leads a unit that is selected to shoot, choose Assault, Heavy, or Rapid Fire 1 to apply to its ranged weapons until the end of the phase.

name: Glory of Ultramar
summary: In your opponent's Shooting phase, if a model in this unit was destroyed by an enemy unit's attacks, this unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

name: Grapnel Launchers
summary: When this unit makes a move, it can move through all types of model, and it ignores all vertical distance for the purposes of how far it has moved.

name: Grav-chutes
summary: This unit has Deep Strike.

name: Grenade Harness
summary: The bearer gains the Grenades keyword.

name: Guiding Hand
summary: While this model leads a unit that is selected to shoot or fight, choose Lethal Hits, Precision, or Sustained Hits 1 to apply to its weapons until the end of the phase.

name: Hail of Bolts
summary: In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, select up to one visible enemy unit. While making those attacks, this unit's Bolt Rifle attacks that targeted that enemy unit have +2 A.

name: Haywire Mine (Once per battle, per unit)
summary: Once per battle, per unit. In your Shooting phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit and roll one D6. On a 2+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; or, if that enemy unit is a VEHICLE unit, it suffers 2D3 mortal wounds instead.

name: Headstrong
summary: Charge rolls made for this unit can be re-rolled; when it makes a Charge move, its melee attacks add 1 to the Hit roll until the end of the turn.

name: HEROES OF ULTRAMAR
summary: At the start of Declare Battle Formations, this unit may join one of several named squads, becoming part of it (raising its Starting Strength) for the rest of the battle; it cannot join an Attached unit.

name: High King of Fenris
summary: Once per battle round, in your Movement phase, you can select one friendly Space Wolves unit that is in Reserves. Until the end of that phase, for the purpose of setting up that unit on the battlefield, the current battle round number counts as one higher than it actually is.

name: Honour Guard
summary: While a Captain or Chapter Master leads this unit, attacks against this unit subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

name: Honour Guard of Macragge
summary: Attacks that target this unit have -1 to wound rolls.

name: Honour of the Company
summary: This unit has +1 OC.

name: Honour of Ultramar
summary: In the fight phase, when this model is destroyed, if its unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6. On a 2+, do not remove this model from the battlefield. The model is removed from the battlefield when its unit has fought, or at the end of the phase, whichever comes first.

name: Hood of Hellfire
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit gain the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against psychic attacks and mortal wounds.

name: Hood of Hellfire (Psychic)
summary: This unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against psychic attacks and mortal wounds.

name: Hunter Missile Targeting
summary: When this model's named weapon attacks a Monster or Vehicle unit, that attack hits on an unmodified Hit roll of 2+.

name: Huskarl to the Jarl
summary: While this model is attached to a unit containing another Character, all Character models in that unit gain the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

name: Icon of Obstinacy
summary: Attacks that target this unit have -1 to hit rolls.

name: Indomitable Assault
summary: When a model in this unit makes a Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of 3".

name: Inspired Retribution
summary: While this model leads a unit, when a model in that unit is destroyed by a melee attack before fighting this phase, roll a D6: on 4+ it fights before removal, then is removed.

name: INSPIRING COMMANDER
summary: While this model is included in your army, until the end of the battle, non-CHARACTER models in Heavy Intercessor Squad units from your army have an Objective Control characteristic of 3 while they are not Battle-shocked.

name: Inspiring Leader
summary: While this model is leading a unit, once per battle, when a Battle-shock test is taken for that unit, you can re-roll that test.

name: Into the Fray
summary: If this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit’s melee attacks have [cleave 1].

name: Iron Father
summary: While this model is within 3" of one or more friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle units, it has the Lone Operative ability.

name: Iron Priest
summary: While this model is within 3" of a friendly Space Wolves Vehicle unit, this model has Lone Operative.

name: Ironclad Assault Launchers
summary: The bearer gains the Grenades keyword.

name: Isolate and Destroy
summary: When this model attacks an enemy unit with no other enemy units within 6" of it, add 1 to the Wound roll.

name: Knight Champion of Macragge
summary: In your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends any move within 8" of this unit, this unit can make a Normal move of up to 6", provided it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit.

name: Knight Champion of Macragge (Once per phase, per army)
summary: Usable once per phase, per army. In the opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, and this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move of up to 6".

name: Last Laugh
summary: If this model is destroyed in melee, after the attacking unit finishes its attacks, roll a D6: on 4+ the attacking unit suffers D6 mortal wounds and becomes Battle-shocked.

name: Leader of Astartes
summary: While this unit is within 3" of a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit, this unit has the Lone Operative ability.

name: Librarian (psyker level 1)
summary: This model has the psychic abilities listed in the Psychic Abilities section.

name: LOGAN GRIMNAR
summary: Your army cannot include both this model and its alternate-mount counterpart.

name: Lord of Slaughter
summary: While this model leads a unit, that unit remains eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Lord of the Pyroclasts
summary: While an enemy unit is engaged with this unit, that enemy unit has -1 OC.

name: Lord of the Wolfkin
summary: While this model leads a unit, when that unit makes a Charge move, its named melee weapons gain the Devastating Wounds ability until the end of the turn.

name: Magna-grapple
summary: The bearer loses the SMOKE keyword. Add 2 to Charge rolls made for the bearer if one or more of the targets of that charge is a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit.

name: Mantle of the Troll King
summary: Once per phase, after making a saving throw against an attack on this model, you may reduce that attack's Damage characteristic to 0.

name: Martial Superiority
summary: When this model makes a melee attack against a Character unit, it can re-roll the Hit roll and re-roll the Wound roll.

name: Master of Battle
summary: At the start of your Command phase, after choosing your Oath of Moment target, name a second enemy unit; if the first target is destroyed before your next Command phase, the second becomes the new target.

name: Master of Manoeuvre
summary: In your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of this model, this model can make a Normal move of up to 6", provided it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit.

name: MASTER OF MISCHIEF
summary: This model cannot be your Warlord.

name: Master of Prescience (Psychic)
summary: This unit has Stealth, and melee attacks that target it take -1 to hit. Once per battle round army-wide, when it is targeted with Counter-offensive, Fire Overwatch, or Heroic Intervention, that use costs -1 CP.

name: Master of Rites
summary: In your Command phase, choose one for this model's unit until the end of the turn: eligible to shoot after Advancing, eligible to charge after Advancing, or eligible to shoot and charge after Falling Back.

name: Master of Shadows
summary: In your Command phase, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, you can re-roll charge rolls for that unit.

name: Master of the Fleet
summary: During the Declare Battle Formations step, if your army includes this model, select one Phobos, Gravis or Tacticus Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army. That unit gains the Deep Strike ability.

name: Master of the Forge
summary: In your Movement phase, at the start or end of this unit's move, you can select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle model within 3" of this model. That Vehicle model heals 3 wounds. That Vehicle model's attacks can ignore modifiers to BS and to Hit rolls and wound rolls until the start of your next Movement phase.

name: Master Tactician
summary: In your Movement phase, you can select one visible friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within 9" of this model, and select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for that unit until the start of your next Command phase.

name: Might of Heroes (Psychic)
summary: While this model leads a unit, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit gain +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Might of Heroes (psychic level 1)
summary: In the Fight phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do: on a 1, this unit is battle-shocked; and this unit's melee attacks have +2 Strength.

name: Morkai’s Howl
summary: In your Shooting phase, target an enemy unit within 12" (18" with a named Lieutenant leading) for a Battle-shock test (-1 if a Psyker); on a fail it is Stunned until your next Shooting phase, at -1 to Hit for its Psychic Attacks.

name: Mortis Strike
summary: When this model makes a ranged attack against a unit that is not Below Half-strength, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

name: Never Shall the Standard Fall
summary: While this unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target this unit with a Strength greater than this unit's Toughness have -1 to wound rolls.

name: Nowhere to Hide
summary: Attacks made by this unit that target a hidden unit add 1 to their Hit rolls.

name: Oath of Rynn
summary: Once per battle, at the start of either Command phase, this model can add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons equipped by models in its unit until the end of the turn.

name: Orbital Comms Array
summary: While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within 6" of this unit, each time you target that unit with a stratagem, roll 1D6: on a 5+, you gain 1 CP.

name: Overlapping Destruction
summary: In your Shooting phase, you can select one enemy unit. This unit's Heavy Bolter weapons that target that enemy unit have [Blast 1].

name: Overlapping Detonations
summary: When this unit shoots, select one visible non-MONSTER/VEHICLE enemy unit: its Heavy Bolter attacks against that unit gain Blast 1.

name: Parabolic Jetleap
summary: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, if this unit is unengaged, you can place this unit in strategic reserves.

name: Pelt of the Doppegangrel
summary: While this model leads a unit, attacks against that unit subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

name: Power of the Machine Spirit
summary: When this unit makes ranged attacks, it can re-roll one hit roll and re-roll one wound roll.

name: Prescience (psychic level 2)
summary: In your Movement phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do: on a 1, this unit is battle-shocked; and this unit has +1 Sv until the start of your next turn.

name: Press the Attack
summary: This unit's melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/vehicle]. Alternatively, if the assault doctrine is active for this unit, this unit's melee attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

name: Primarch of the XIII (Aura)
summary: Aura. While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within 6" of this unit, that unit's attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and re-roll wound rolls of 1.

name: Priority Target Identified (Once per battle, per unit)
summary: Once per battle, per unit. In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one visible terrain feature; that terrain feature is identified until the end of the turn. While an enemy unit is within an identified terrain feature, that enemy unit has +3" detection range.

name: Psychic Hood (Psychic)
summary: This unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against psychic attacks.

name: Punishing Bombardment
summary: In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, select one enemy INFANTRY unit hit by Whirlwind Vengeance Launcher attacks. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll.

name: Purgation Run
summary: After this unit shoots, it can make a Normal move of up to D6"; if it does, it cannot declare a charge this turn.

name: Raise the Banner
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured.

name: Rampart
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, this model can gain a 2+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase.

name: Rampart (Once per battle, per army)
summary: Usable once per battle, per army. At the start of any phase, you can use this ability. If you do, this model has 2+ InSv until the end of that phase.

name: Rapid Disembarkation
summary: In your Movement phase, when this unit ends an Advance move, units embarked within this unit can each make a shock disembark move.

name: Refractor Field
summary: Gives the bearer a 5+ invulnerable save.

name: Refuse to Accept Defeat
summary: While this model leads a unit, its attacks add 1 to the Hit roll if the unit is below Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if Below Half-strength.

name: Righteous Fury (Once per battle, per army)
summary: Once per battle, per army. In the Fight phase, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit's melee attacks have +1 Strength, and when this unit has fought, this model heals D3 wounds; or, if this model destroyed an enemy model this phase, this model heals 2D3 wounds instead.

name: Rites of Tempering
summary: Attacks that target this unit with a Strength characteristic greater than this unit's Toughness characteristic have -1 to their wound rolls.

name: Rites of Thermal Appeasement
summary: This unit adds 1 to hazard rolls made for its Plasma Incinerator and Plasma Pistol weapons.

name: Second Company Banner
summary: While this unit contains Ancient Gadriel, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in this unit. While this unit contains both Ancient Gadriel and Captain Titus, also improve the Leadership characteristic of models in this unit by 1.

name: Seeker of the Unfound
summary: The first time this model deploys, choose an objective marker; while within range of it, this model gains an Objective Control characteristic of 10, a Leadership characteristic of 5+, and the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

name: Sentinel Protocols (Once per phase, per unit)
summary: Once per phase, per unit: you can target this unit with the Fire Overwatch stratagem regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do, this unit's snap shooting attacks hit on unmodified hit rolls of 4+ until that stratagem is resolved, and that use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

name: Sentry Programming (Once per phase, per unit)
summary: Once per phase, per unit: you can target this unit with the Fire Overwatch stratagem regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do: that use is -1 CP, and that use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

name: Shadowmaster
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit cannot be targeted by ranged attacks unless the attacker is within 12".

name: Shattered Defences
summary: In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, select one enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit hit by those attacks. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units' ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have +1 AP.

name: Shield of Sanguinius (Aura, Psychic)
summary: While a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is within 6" of this model, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds and Psychic Attacks.

name: Shrouding (psychic level 1)
summary: When an enemy unit targets this unit, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do: on a 1, this unit is battle-shocked; and attacks that target this unit have -1 to hit rolls until the end of the phase.

name: Siege-breaker Protocols
summary: When this model makes a melee attack against a Vehicle or Fortification unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

name: Siege Captain
summary: When this model attacks a Monster, Vehicle, or Fortification unit, improve that attack's Strength, Armour Penetration, and Damage characteristics by 2.

name: Signum Array
summary: In your Shooting phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit. That enemy unit cannot have the benefit of cover.

name: Skilled Riders
summary: Each time a model in this model's unit makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, that model can move horizontally through terrain features.

name: Skyfire Protocols
summary: When this model is targeted with the Overwatch Stratagem against a Fly unit that just moved, you may also target up to three further Fly units within 24" with its named weapon, each needing an unmodified 6 to hit.

name: Smoke Launchers
summary: The bearer loses the Magna-grapple ability and gains the Smoke keyword.

name: Soul Sight (psychic level 1)
summary: Psychic level 1. In your Shooting phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do: on a 1, this unit is battle-shocked; and select one visible enemy unit — ranged attacks that target that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].

name: Spear of Chogoris
summary: This unit's ranged attacks have [Assault]. When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge. While the assault doctrine is active for this unit, this unit has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.

name: Special-issue Optics and Ammunition
summary: In your Shooting phase, when this unit is selected to shoot, you can select one of the following: this unit's ranged attacks have [Ignores Cover]; or select one enemy unit within 24" of this unit, and that enemy unit has +6" detection range until this unit has shot.

name: Specialised Weapon System
summary: When this model attacks the enemy unit selected for Oath of Moment, that attack gains the Ignores Cover ability and its Indirect Fire attacks ignore the non-visible target penalty to Hit rolls.

name: Speed of the Hunter
summary: Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this model's unit.

name: Spiritual Leader (Once per battle round, per unit)
summary: Usable once per battle round, per unit. At the start of any phase, you can select one friendly battle-shocked ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within 6" of this model. That unit is no longer battle-shocked.

name: Storm Assault
summary: Each time a unit disembarks from this model after this model has made a Normal move, that unit makes an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 18.06) for that disembarkation.

name: Strafing Enfilade
summary: When this model ends a Normal move, target a non-Monster, non-Vehicle enemy unit it moved over and roll six D6: each 4+ deals 1 mortal wound to that unit.

name: Strategic Acumen
summary: In your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, select one combat doctrine; that doctrine is active for this unit until the start of your next Command phase.

name: Strategium Command
summary: After both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units. When redeploying them this way, you can place those units in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

name: Supreme Strategist
summary: Once per battle round, one unit from your army with this ability can use it when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit within 12" of that model is targeted with a Stratagem. If it does, reduce the CP cost of that usage of that Stratagem by 1CP.

name: Tactical Fluidity (Once per battle round, per unit)
summary: Once per battle round, this unit can use one of the following options. In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, if this unit is unengaged, it can make a normal move of up to D6". Or, at the end of your opponent's Fight phase, if this unit is engaged, it can make a fall-back move of up to 6".

name: Tactical Mainstay
summary: Being engaged or battle-shocked does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action. When this unit starts an action, that action does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot.

name: Talonmaster
summary: While this model is within 3" of one or more other friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted or Adeptus Astartes Fly Vehicle units, this model has the Lone Operative ability.

name: Tank Commander
summary: While this model is commanding a VEHICLE model: ranged weapons equipped by that VEHICLE model have a Ballistic Skill characteristic of 2+; and each time that VEHICLE model is selected to shoot, you can re-roll one Wound roll when resolving those attacks.

name: Targeted Intercession
summary: If this unit made a charge move this turn, this unit's melee attacks have +1 S and +1 AP.

name: Telepathic Assault (psychic level 1)
summary: In your Shooting phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do: on a 1, this unit is battle-shocked; and select one visible enemy unit within 24" of this unit, which suffers 2D3 mortal wounds.

name: Teleport Homer (Once per battle, per unit)
summary: Once per battle, per unit. At the start of the battle, you can set up one Teleport Homer token for this unit on the battlefield. If you do: when you target this unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, you can use that token; if you do, that use is -1 CP, but when resolving that Stratagem this unit must be set up within 3" of that token and not within 8" of an enemy unit, and that token is then removed from the battlefield. If an enemy unit ends a move within 1" of that token, that token is removed from the battlefield.

name: The Fierce Eye
summary: In your Shooting phase, target an enemy Infantry unit within 12" and visible to this model; that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

name: The Great Wolf
summary: Each time this model destroys an enemy unit, gain 1CP.

name: The Red Grail
summary: While this model leads a unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit.

name: Thunderhawk Insertion
summary: In the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select one friendly Gravis, Phobos, or Tacticus unit. That unit has the Deep Strike ability.

name: Thunderous Force (psychic level 1)
summary: In your Shooting phase, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do: on a 1, this unit is battle-shocked; and this unit's ranged attacks have +6" R.

name: To the Last
summary: While this model leads a unit, its attacks add 1 to the Hit roll if the unit is below Starting Strength, and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if Below Half-strength.

name: Tremor Shells
summary: After this unit shoots, if its named weapon hit an enemy Infantry unit, until the end of the opponent's next turn that unit is shaken: -2 to Move and -2 to Advance and Charge rolls.

name: Trifold Path of Shadow
summary: This unit has the Stealth ability. This unit also has -3" detection range.

name: TYCHO
summary: Your army cannot include both this model and its alternate version.

name: Tyrannic War Veterans
summary: Weapons equipped by models in this unit gain the Devastating Wounds ability when targeting Tyranids units.

name: Ultramarines Bodyguard
summary: While this model is within 3" of one or more friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry units, this model has the Lone Operative ability.

name: Ultramarines Honour Guard
summary: While a Captain or Chapter Master leads this unit, attacks against this unit subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

name: Unorthodox Strategist (Aura)
summary: Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit within 12" of this model with a Stratagem, you can increase that Stratagem's CP cost by 1.

name: Unrelenting and Uncompromising
summary: While this model leads a unit, attacks made by models in that unit can ignore modifiers to Ballistic Skill, Weapon Skill, or the Hit roll.

name: Unstoppable Valour
summary: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit.

name: Unto the Anvil
summary: This unit's melee attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1. Or, if the assault doctrine is active for this unit, this unit's melee attacks can re-roll wound rolls.

name: Vanquish the Foe
summary: When this model attacks an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

name: Veil of Time (psychic level 1)
summary: When this unit is selected to make an advance move, if this unit is not battle-shocked, you can make a psychic roll for this unit by rolling one D6. If you do: on a 1, this unit is battle-shocked; and this unit can change that advance roll to a 6.

name: Veiling Smoke (Once per phase, per unit)
summary: Once per phase, per unit: you can target this unit with the Smokescreen stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do, that use is -1 CP, and that use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

name: Veteran Bodyguard
summary: While this model is attached to a unit, other CHARACTER models in this unit have Feel No Pain 4+.

name: Veteran Marksmen
summary: When this unit makes ranged attacks, it can re-roll hit rolls of 1 for those attacks.

name: Vivispectral Analysis Targeting
summary: Attacks made by this unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability when the target does not have the Vehicle keyword.

name: Voice of Experience
summary: While this model leads a unit, improve its Objective Control characteristic by 1 and add 1 to the Hit roll for its attacks.

name: Whirlwind of Gore
summary: When this model fights, add 1 to its named weapon's Attacks characteristic for every 5 enemy models within 6" of it, for that fight.

name: Wings of Sanguinius (Psychic)
summary: Once per turn, at the end of your Movement phase, one Psyker with this ability rolls one D6: on a 1 it suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 2+ redeploy a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit within 12", more than 8" horizontally from enemies.

name: Wisdom of the Ancients
summary: While a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is within 6" of this model, that unit's attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

name: WOLFKIN
summary: This model cannot be your Warlord and cannot be given Enhancements.

name: Wrath of the Machine Spirit
summary: This unit's ranged attacks that target a unit within 12" of this unit have [Devastating Wounds: non-Monster/vehicle].

name: Wrathful Rampage
summary: When this model fights, target an enemy unit within Engagement Range and roll a D6 (+2 if it charged this turn): 4-5 deals D3 mortal wounds, 6+ deals 3 mortal wounds.

name: Zealot’s Fervour
summary: This model's unit remains eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

name: Zealous Fortitude
summary: This unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

name: Combat Doctrines
summary: At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine; it is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase. Assault Doctrine: an advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge. Devastator Doctrine: this unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]. Tactical Doctrine: a fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge. Each doctrine can be selected once per battle; only one is active per unit, and a new one ends the previous.

name: Curse of the Wulfen
summary: While this unit is within 6" of a friendly SPACE WOLVES CHARACTER model (excluding WULFEN models), or within 12" of a friendly WOLF PRIEST model, and this unit is not battle-shocked: if this unit has INFANTRY, it has +1 OC; if this unit has VEHICLE, it has +3 OC. Bestial Forms: for the purposes of transport capacity, each WULFEN model takes up the space of 2 models.

name: Librarius
summary: ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name. In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit's psyker level.

name: Mission Tactics
summary: At the start of your Command phase you can select a Mission Tactic, active until your next Command phase for your Adeptus Astartes units: Sustained Hits 1, Lethal Hits, or Precision on Critical Hits. Each can be selected once per battle.

name: Oath of Moment
summary: If your Army Faction is Adeptus Astartes, at the start of your Command phase select one enemy unit as your Oath of Moment target until your next Command phase. Each time a model with this ability attacks that target you can re-roll the Hit roll. If you use a Codex: Space Marines Detachment and your army includes no Black Templars, Blood Angels, Dark Angels, Deathwatch or Space Wolves units, also add 1 to the Wound roll.

name: Templar Vows
summary: ADEPTUS ASTARTES armies: at the first battle round's start, select one Vow for those units: - melee attacks vs PSYKER have [PRECISION]; with an enemy PSYKER within 12", may re-roll a charge roll, ending engaged with one. - add 1 to melee Wound rolls if Strength <= target Toughness. - can charge after Falling Back; Pile-in/Consolidation moves need only end as close as possible to the closest enemy unit. - INFANTRY: objectives within range you control at each Command phase end stay yours until the opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours at end of a phase; can start Actions after Advancing.

name: Transhuman Strategist
summary: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.
